failure_policy: Publish failure, every completed checkpoint and stopping reason; no test-selected retries.

split_rule.fresh_holdout: Excluded30 unit pairs, both tens9;30 complete strings, evaluated once after validation selection.
split_rule.independence_limits: Fresh strings and unit pairs unseen by NEW training, including reverse exclusion; all100 unit computations historically exposed in old fixture. This is not new independent arithmetic knowledge or100 independent sums.
split_rule.old_test: Original exposed30 retained as diagnostic only after selection; never used to update or select.
split_rule.train: All70 development unit pairs crossed with both tens digits1..8;4480 complete strings.
split_rule.units_pairs: Sort 45 unordered distinct digit pairs by SHA256 ASCII az-unseen-residue-v1:a:b; first15 and their reversals form30 fresh heldout residue pairs; complementary70 are development pairs.
split_rule.validation: Development unit pairs, left tens9 right tens8;70 complete strings.

task: Two-digit operands, sum modulo10, one digit answer; no arithmetic features at inference.

training.loss: Cross-entropy ONLY on answer target at teacher-forced target index5; prompt ends in equals and contains no answer.
training.selection: Minimum validation answer cross-entropy, ties earlier checkpoint; one seed, no restarts.
